description: Find Indian insurance products by words in the name, insurer (slug), type of insurance (category slug from list_categories), line (life, health, general) or status (active, withdrawn). A UIN in q returns that product. Start here when you only have a name.

category.description: Category slug, e.g. health-indemnity, term-life, motor-car

insurer.description: Insurer slug from get_insurer or the results

q.description: Product name words or a UIN

name: search_policies
